citations.quote: Bea Borres and her former boyfriend Meray Yamada recently appeared together in a candid clip, but she made one thing clear from the beginning: their reunion does not mean they are co-parenting their daughter, Victoria Hope.
The former couple’s unexpected interaction was featured as a “bonus clip” in Bea’s latest vlog, which she later reposted on Facebook and quickly caught the attention of netizens.
Bea Borres and her ex-boyfriend, Meray Yamada, reunited in front of the camera for content.
Recently, the celebrity mom met up with Meray for what she jokingly described as a "clout-chasing" move for her vlog.
Content creator Bea Borres featured her ex-boyfriend, Meray Yamada , as a special guest in her latest vlog.
The former couple recently appeared together in a five-minute “bonus clip” from Bea’s latest vlog, which she later reposted on Facebook.
CEBU, Philippines — Nagkita pag-usab atubangan sa camera ang aktres ug content creator nga si Bea Borres ug iyang ex-boyfriend nga si Meray Yamada alang sa usa ka online content.
READ: Bea Borres reveals the face of her daughter Hope: ‘Too beautiful to not share’ Before bringing Meray into the frame, Bea immediately gave a disclaimer behind their reunion.
When Meray finally appeared, Bea continued to make light of the situation while referencing their difficult past.
Meray admitted that their reunion was unexpected and that he had no idea what Bea had planned.
The three of them briefly appeared together and smiled at the camera.
Their appearance together was specifically for the vlog and the engagement it could generate.
In a YouTube vlog titled "Hot Moms Bake with Jam Magno," Bea inserted a short clip toward the latter part of the video, where she let Meray try the cake she baked.
According to Bea, she purposely included Meray in the vlog to drive online engagement, which could then generate income.
Content creator Bea Borres breaks her silence amid the mixed reactions to her reunion with her ex-boyfriend Meray Yamada.
Bea also playfully said that reuniting with her ex would help her earn money for their daughter, Victoria Hope.

The influencer also added in the comments, "If I promote sugal diba you'll bash me rin naman, go kanya-kanya na 'tong hustle." The following day, Bea Borres continued sharing content featuring Meray. Titled "Gatasan Serye," the new video showed Bea and Baby Hopea watching Meray play basketball.
However, Bea herself made it clear that she and Meray are not co-parenting, emphasizing that their reunion was primarily made for content and engagement.

Sa YouTube vlog nga “Hot Moms Bake with Jam Magno,” gipakita ni Bea ang mubo nga video clip diin iyang gipatilaw si Meray sa hinimo niya nga cake.Suma pa ni Bea, gituyo niyang ilakip si Meray sa vlog aron madugangan ang online engagement ug mokita siya niini.Aduna na’y anak sila Bea ug Meray nga ginganlan og Hope .
